alt: The recording audio_files/greeting.wav is transcribed by LiteLLMTranscriber("whisper-1") into one AudioTranscription row (filename, text) in the Postgres table coco_examples.audio_transcriptions, keyed by filename; replacing pipeline_note.wav re-transcribes only that file, and a SELECT returns each filename with a preview of its transcript.

run.note: Add recordings (two samples ship with the Rust twin)

run.cmd: psql "postgres://cocoindex:cocoindex@localhost/cocoindex" -c 'SELECT filename, left(text, 200) AS preview FROM coco_examples.audio_transcriptions ORDER BY filename;'
